# Instructions for GitHub Copilot

Read and follow `CLAUDE.md` at the repository root. It holds the rules and verified facts of this
project, in particular:

- `src/collector.js` must stay ES5 (Zabbix runs it in Duktape).
- `templates/*.yaml` is generated by `tools/generate_templates.py`: never edit it by hand.
- Only query Druid fields listed in `docs/intersight_metrics.json` (no inferred metric names).
- Run `tools/ci.sh` before every commit.
